sources.title: ERA5 Land hourly time-series data from 1950 to present
sources.credential_requirement: CDS account, accepted terms, and configured ~/.cdsapirc
sources.license_note: Record the CDS dataset terms and citation shown at retrieval time.
sources.version_policy: Record retrieval timestamp and CDS request because the service exposes a continuously maintained product.

surface_solar_radiation_downwards.accumulation_semantics: Hourly de-accumulated energy according to the CDS time-series product label; divide by 3600 for hourly mean W m-2 or sum by UTC day and divide by 86400 for daily mean W m-2.

total_precipitation.accumulation_semantics: Hourly de-accumulated depth according to the CDS time-series product label; clip packing noise within the declared tolerance to zero before daily summation.

sources.title: NASA Earth Exchange Global Daily Downscaled Projections CMIP6
sources.access_method: NCCS THREDDS NetCDF Subset Service; AWS S3 is a secondary full-object source
sources.credential_requirement: No credential was required for the NCCS catalog and point-subset smoke request on 2026-07-24; recheck if service policy changes.
sources.license_note: CMIP6 model licensing can differ by institution; preserve source model license and citation metadata.
sources.version_policy: Use annual v2.0 files and pin product version, model-specific realization from the study registry, grid label, variable, experiment, year, catalog URL, and exact NCSS request URL.

hurs.harmonization_rule: preserve raw values; clip values outside 0-100 percent only in canonical products and report the count

metadata_repairs.scope: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 annual v2.0 files for all declared experiments
metadata_repairs.policy: Apply only when the upstream units attribute is absent. Preserve the immutable source file and reject every non-empty unit outside the accepted-unit list.
evidence: NASA NCCS OPeNDAP DAS for FGOALS-g3 historical r3i1p1f1 tasmin 1985 omits all descriptive tasmin attributes including units: https://ds.nccs.nasa.gov/thredds/dodsC/AMES/NEX/GDDP-CMIP6/FGOALS-g3/historical/r3i1p1f1/tasmin/tasmin_day_FGOALS-g3_historical_r3i1p1f1_gn_1985_v2.0.nc.das

The companion FGOALS-g3 historical r3i1p1f1 tasmax 1985 DAS declares standard_name air_temperature and units K: https://ds.nccs.nasa.gov/thredds/dodsC/AMES/NEX/GDDP-CMIP6/FGOALS-g3/historical/r3i1p1f1/tasmax/tasmax_day_FGOALS-g3_historical_r3i1p1f1_gn_1985_v2.0.nc.das
All 90 staged FGOALS-g3 tasmin annual subsets across historical, ssp245, and ssp585 omit units and have temperature-scale values within the registered 180-350 K physical gate.
